name: jev-conductor-router
description: Decide with Jev whether a coding task needs a Conductor cloud workspace, route the harness and model, and operate that workspace over MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Route coding tasks to Conductor with Jev.
interface.longDescription: Uses Jev to decide whether a task needs a Conductor cloud workspace, how hard it is, and which harness and model to use, then calls the public Conductor API.
